test: [INV-SCH-08] falsifier: three days with listening off at 20 sessions a day
what: Listening exercises switched OFF for three days, then back on. Three hundred items whose only form is listening sit behind the toggle. Leave their clocks running and re-enabling buries new material under a several-hundred-item false backlog that the learner did nothing to earn.
measured: 2026-09-11. The due set among held rows at the moment of re-enable is identical to the due set at the moment of disable; held milliseconds equal the full window; nothing is generable while the modality is off; an item that can still be read is not held at all.
